title: An Improved Baseline for Sentence-level Relation Extraction
reading_scope: Primary researcher read extracted PDF pages1-3, including task input and entity-marker method definitions; later experiment pages and appendices unread.
source_facts: Sentence-level relation extraction is formulated with entity names, spans and NER types.
The method distinguishes entity markers, punctuation markers, typed entity markers and typed punctuation markers.
Typed punctuation embeds subject/object types into marked input, then fine-tunes a PLM classifier.
project_findings: Current marked_words() implementation uses untyped punctuation and explicitly excludes type metadata.
Later same-input comparisons must account for types as additional explicit information.
limits: Entity-type input is established prior art, not novelty.
Its reported F1 and fine-tuned encoder protocol are not directly comparable to our positive39 Macro with a frozen encoder.
Reading these method pages is not a comprehensive novelty search or independent quantum evidence.
